description:
Flannan Isles: The Coat Left Behind

A source-led check of the 1900 Flannan Isles lighthouse disappearance. We compare Joseph Moore’s contemporary account and the Northern Lighthouse Board investigation with the later details repeated in popular versions. McArthur’s wearing coat was left at the station; that fact does not prove what happened next. The official inquiry proposed that a large sea swept the men away near the west landing, but no one witnessed the disappearance. The original lighthouse logbook is not held by the Northern Lighthouse Board, so dramatic quotations need careful sourcing. This is a mystery with a documented record and genuine limits—not a solved supernatural story.
